[{"Name":"Bishnu Pratap Singh","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX1ZHFo4x3i1pp5K6Z1tDL53aXzwxTZTU7j0TckvqvEhU5S0KlnSA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"My experience with Universal College of Medical and Dental Sciences Teaching Hospital (UCMS), Nepal has been truly excellent.

The doctors here are not just knowledgeable, but more importantly honest, ethical, and deeply dedicated to patient care. I am not comparing doctors based on degrees or expertise, but on honesty and commitment, and in that sense, UCMS stands far above many hospitals.

In India, especially in Gorakhpur, I have personally seen that once the EDD date approaches, many hospitals do not wait for the natural process. They often create fear by mentioning unnecessary complications and strongly push for C-section deliveries, mainly for financial reasons. This is the unfortunate reality in many Indian hospitals.

Initially, my wife was receiving treatment at one of the best hospitals in Gorakhpur during the early stage of pregnancy. But when we felt that things were not going in the right direction, we decided to shift to UCMS Hospital — and that decision changed everything.

At UCMS:

Doctors are very patient, transparent, and supportive

Nurses and staff are extremely caring and cooperative

The hospital maintains excellent cleanliness and hygiene

No unnecessary pressure for surgery; the natural process is fully respected

My daughter was born 4 days after the EDD, and that too through a normal delivery, which would likely not have been allowed in many hospitals in India.

I am truly grateful to the doctors, nurses, and the entire staff for their care and support.
The only small drawback is that there is no paid accommodation for patient attendants, but apart from this, everything is excellent.

Thank you UCMS Hospital.
Thank you to the doctors, nurses, and staff.
You gave us trust, care, and a beautiful beginning for our daughter’s life. ❤️","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Traveller Nepal","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXI0PVZhBOoXrDSVqIPZMYcrUEaqoC_wM_6j0Swf5734HFzlbU=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"Universal College of Medical Sciences or UCMS is the only medical college in Bhairahawa. It is located in Rupandehi district which is just 15 kilometres away from the birthplace of Buddha, Lumbini. The Universal College of Medical Sciences has got the recognition and is considered as a missionary college in the field of medical and dental courses. The Universal college of medical sciences was started with MBBS and BDS and at present, it proposes masters courses too like MS and MD. The international runway, terminal building, and basic operational systems reflect planning aimed at long-term growth and improved connectivity. These features position the airport as an important emerging gateway for both regional and international travel.

Despite this progress, the domestic facilities at the airport do not yet meet the standards expected of a fully functional international airport. The domestic terminal’s layout, passenger handling capacity, and overall service quality remain below the benchmarks set by international aviation authorities. Essential components such as passenger amenities, baggage processing systems, and require further development to ensure smooth and efficient operations.

The gap between the airport’s international potential and its current domestic readiness highlights the need for targeted upgrades. Enhancing operational efficiency, improving passenger services, and expanding supporting infrastructure, such as transportation access and internal connectivity, will be vital for raising the airport to international standards.

In summary, while Gautam Buddha International Airport has a strong foundational infrastructure, significant improvements in domestic facilities and services are necessary.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBE7HmKVCfFFHXqVv2loikw&fid=0x0:0x9d94b83c7a557e91"],"When":"2025-11-19"},{"Name":"Awadhesh Kumar Kurmi","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWDsONHqLNcnbIOP0dHa_W6_oKDQ3DrFJ4kYPCZS-BV-qipmIrDrA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Due to the lack of proper systems and accurate information, flights are often delayed. I went to the airport, and my ticket had 1 carry on bag, a personal item, and a 20 kg checkin baggage allowances. My carry on was 7 kg, and check in bag was 24 kg. First the lady staff asked me to take 1-2 kg from my check in baggage to Carry on or backpack to avoid fee for extra weight. While I was doing that one airport staff came towards me, and he had nothing to do with Air Asia and this check in process. We chatted in nepali as normal while I was still trying to figure out what to take out from the luggage. He went to the counter and came back to tell me if I pay  kharcha-paani (Nepali slang word for bribe) to her, then I can check my bag as is. I straight denied to pay bribe and said I would rather adust my baggages or pay the fee for extra weight. Now lady didn't like it and went on retaliation mode. She said I couldn't put anything in carry on bag now because it's exact 7 kg and even demanded to weight my backpack. I paid the airlines instead of bribe and told them in the face how immoral and disgusting they are.

I have flown Numbers of time  and I never had an issue with 1-2 kg extras in check in and Carry on. Most airlines let you take up to 10 kg in carry on because the bag itself weighs 3-3.5 kg. Le logement est situé sur le rooftop de la maison familiale. Il est de très bonne qualité et neuf. Vous disposerez d'une grande chambre de trois personnes, avec sa salle de bain (eau chaude et serviette comprise), ainsi qu'une cuisine et d'un espace extérieur (fauteuil, table, balancelle). Il y a tout à disposition (très bonne wifi, fil à linge, épingle, cintre, eau filtrée, de quoi grignoter ...). Rien à redire, mieux que ce que j'avais espérer que j'ai changé mes plans pour prolonger mon séjour.
Facile à trouver, l'emplacement sur Booking est bon ou via Google maps sous le nom "Gautam BNB", près de Buddha Chowk.
Idéalement situé au calme et à 1 minute à pied de la route principale où vous pouvez prendre les tuktuk ou les bus locaux (pour aller à Lumbini par exemple). Toutes commodités aux alentours (restaurants, boulangerie, grand supermarché à 10min à pied etc)

En ce qui concerne cette famille, ils ont été d'une gentillesse incroyable. Nous avons échangé quelques discussions, ils m'ont offert le thé et le dinner à deux reprises. Ils m'ont aidé à trouver le bus et le matin de mon départ, le monsieur est allé sur la route principale pour faire amener un tuktuk directement et me conduire, au prix local.
Leur sourire et leur hospitalité sont sans failles.

Très bon rapport qualité prix, je recommande les yeux fermés !!

Truly reccomend it.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAcMrZ-zOYY90wAvG5Ju-h3&fid=0x0:0x4d346fdbab265ba2"],"When":"2025-12-29"},{"Name":"Lila Mani Sharma","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVJm6Q743cdDCLaEskvzAS84eoedX2cn8lXd316RdPpo2gCj8k=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"A village tour in Lumbini is a beautiful way to experience the real heart of Nepal beyond the sacred gardens.
Lumbini is known worldwide as the birthplace of Lord Buddha, but just outside the Monastic Zone, peaceful villages welcome you with warm smiles, simple lifestyles, and deep cultural traditions.
🌾 What You Experience in a Lumbini Village Tour
1. Authentic Tharu Culture
Meet the indigenous Tharu community, see their traditional mud houses, colorful wall art, and learn about their unique customs, dress, and festivals.
2. Local Farming Life
Walk through green fields of rice, wheat, and mustard. Depending on the season, you may see farmers ploughing with oxen, harvesting crops, or preparing traditional tools.
3. Traditional Food & Hospitality
Enjoy home-cooked Nepali meals made with fresh, organic ingredients. The hospitality is simple but full of heart.
4. Bicycle or Walking Tour
The flat landscape makes cycling very enjoyable. Riding through quiet village roads gives you a peaceful and close connection with local life.
5. Spiritual Atmosphere
While Lumbini is the center of Buddhist pilgrimage, the surrounding villages also reflect calmness, kindness, and simplicity — values deeply connected to Buddha’s teachings.
🌿 Why It Is Special
A village tour is not only sightseeing — it is experience sharing.
You see real Nepal, feel rural peace, and understand how communities live in harmony with nature.
For visitors who come to Lumbini for spiritual reasons, a village tour adds a human and cultural dimension to their journey.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCWhywWlFlB3KCA24LGK_W_&fid=0x0:0x4d346fdbab265ba2"],"When":"2026-2-21"},{"Name":"Franco Pena","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK4-WVhxlqK3K_zztRiQRASgZA50MKg55FQ1kKe4HTuY9g5gQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I rented a mountain bike for visiting Lumbini's temples. We ordered three non-vegetarian mutton thalis, two naans, and a mix of vegetables. While the naan and mix veg were satisfactory, the mutton was extremely disappointing. It seemed old and poorly cooked, accompanied by an unpleasant smell.
When we brought this issue to the attention of our waiter, we unfortunately received no response. Frustrated, I approached the kitchen to address the matter directly with the chef. He acknowledged the smell and admitted there was indeed a problem with the mutton. This raised serious concerns—are they playing with our health?
To make matters worse, we noticed that not only the mutton, but the dal also had a bad smell, which fellow diners at nearby tables echoed. Initially, the restaurant served fresh food, but it seems they were recycling leftovers during our visit.
When we raised our voices at the counter regarding the situation, the staff merely acknowledged the issue with the mutton and suggested it should have been thrown out. It's unacceptable for a restaurant to serve food that poses health risks to its customers.
I have always recommended Aagan Restaurant and Thakali Ghar to my guests and friends, but after this experience, I can confidently say that this will be my last visit. We did not pay for the three mutton thalis but settled the remaining amount before leaving, feeling thoroughly disappointed.
I hope they take this feedback seriously and improve their food safety standards.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCCGeMlARfVRZ-GCZg3Ekan&fid=0x0:0x43b90b88881b2890"],"When":"2025-11-10"},{"Name":"Dimpal Rayamajhi","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIPzCQ-2FeBQ0PEVk2vZ5ui1lP8HvrNx__I1v1welYu3jGA8g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We went there to celebrate my chhori’s birthday, and we are truly grateful for the warm hospitality and excellent service. The place was extremely noisy, making it unsuitable for anyone looking for a peaceful dining, breakfast, or lunch atmosphere.  The staff behaviour was not welcoming or professional, which further added to the discomfort.
The food didn't meet expectations either - the mo:mo locked flavour and freshness.  Additionally,  they were charging NPR 50 for a regular processed water bottle that had a printed MRP of only NPR 20,  which is unfair, especially since it was not even their own branded bottle.  When I pointed this out, they didn't provide any explanation or response, which felt very unprofessional. It makes you wonder why the tax office isn't more serious about such price discrepancies.
Given the noise, poor staff behaviour, and overpriced items, I wouldn't recommend this place for families or anyone looking for a peaceful dining experience.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgMDo-uGS0wE&fid=0x0:0x9154371615c540b2"],"When":"2025-4-24"},{"Name":"Prateek Pradhan","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWh8LUitAAsvLSXDYeHUdF2UAsT1Q2hfzHwnPL8DUwXpsfI8Fr7yQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Chicken momo and Butter chicken with rice were excellent.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBshZIOdXX3pRvshqlcFcPt&fid=0x0:0x9154371615c540b2"],"When":"2026-2-3"},{"Name":"Ashis Rai","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWC4T5ieWaP4ID1yi14CKzZxTeT5cS4ADmtO0meO4uJLWmhQXRfYw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Visited this place in afternoon and they were just starting. The service was warm and welcoming, and the staff really made us feel looked after. It’s the kind of place where you can enjoy a relaxed dinner with family or friends and leave completely satisfied.

The ambiance was cozy and welcoming, with attentive and polite staff who made the whole experience even better. The service was quick, and the cleanliness of the restaurant was impressive.
